notes: During 2002, on an average, around 105 seizures were made in a day and the average value of property seized per day
in such seizures amounted to around Rs. 1.0 crore. The type and value of commodities seized may be seen in Table 9(B).
As compared to previous year, smuggling of all items decreased. The quantity of Gold smuggled in 2002 declined by
